method.name: uncertainty-aware graph stress propagation and counterfactual resilience screening
method.stress_formula: 0.45 utilization + 0.25 endpoint risk + 0.20 propagated node risk + 0.10 loss proxy
method.criticality_formula: 0.55 dynamic stress + 0.25 edge betweenness + 0.15 disconnection rate + 0.05 hop increase
method.caveat: screening proxy; not a substitute for AC power flow, thermal limits, or N-1 certification
